description: This file defines the CrosvmManager class, a specific implementation of the VmManager interface for managing crosvm virtual machines within the Android Cuttlefish project. It declares methods for checking support, configuring graphics and boot devices, starting commands, and waiting for restore completion.

classes.name: CrosvmManager
classes.description: A class managing crosvm-based virtual machine instances, extending the VmManager interface and providing implementations for VM support checks, configuration, and control functions.

methods.name: std::string name()
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this VM manager implementation.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if crosvm virtualization is supported on the host system.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics settings for the guest VM based on instance-specific configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot device settings for the guest VM.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the commands required to start the VM, given the configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: WaitForRestoreComplete
methods.description: Waits for the VM restore process to complete, with the ability to stop waiting via a file descriptor.
